entries.title: Your reply is answered on the card you wrote under
entries.body: When you reply under a crewmate's card, its answer now stays on that card, even when the crewmate also puts up a new card. Crewmates no longer answer into a card that is already closed while your reply waits on another one.
entries.noPicture: This changes where a crewmate's answer goes and what its reminders name, not how a card looks.
